title: Shermer's 1983 alien abduction experience during Race Across America

tellings.quote: I did have an alien induction experience in 1983. I was traveling along a lonely rural highway near Hegler, Nebraska,

plain: A well-known skeptic and writer named Michael Shermer says that in 1983, while riding in the Race Across America, a bicycle race across the country, he had what he calls an alien abduction experience on a lonely rural highway near Haigler, Nebraska. He mentions the cyclist Eric Heiden and says he described the episode in an interview on ABC's Wide World of Sports, a television sports show. He tells it as something he lived through himself.
